cycleTypes.label: Broiler Grow-Out
cycleTypes.about: Day-old chicks → live weight / slaughter. Typically 35–45 days.

cycleTypes.label: Layer — from Day-Old
cycleTypes.about: Day-old chicks → pullets → full lay. Includes brooding & growing phases.

cycleTypes.label: Layer — from Point-of-Lay
cycleTypes.about: Start with 18-week+ pullets ready to lay.

cycleTypes.label: Layer — Continuing Flock
cycleTypes.about: Already-laying flock, tracking ongoing production season.

cycleTypes.label: Egg Incubation & Hatch
cycleTypes.about: Set fertile eggs → candle → lock-down → hatch → chick grading.

cycleTypes.label: Breeder Flock
cycleTypes.about: Roosters + hens managed for fertile egg production.

cycleTypes.label: Turkey Grow-Out
cycleTypes.about: Poults → market weight. Typically 16–20 weeks.

cycleTypes.label: Duck Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Ducklings → meat or layer production.

cycleTypes.label: Quail Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Quail chicks → eggs or meat.

cycleTypes.label: Dairy Production Season
cycleTypes.about: Track lactation, milk yield, breeding and dry-off for a dairy herd.

cycleTypes.label: Beef Grow-Out
cycleTypes.about: Weaners / stockers → slaughter weight.

cycleTypes.label: Pig Grow-Out
cycleTypes.about: Weaners → market weight. Typically 16–20 weeks post-weaning.

cycleTypes.label: Sow Farrowing Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Pregnancy → farrowing → weaning for a sow or group of sows.

cycleTypes.label: Goat Production Season
cycleTypes.about: Dairy or meat goats — kidding, milking, or grow-out.

cycleTypes.label: Sheep Season
cycleTypes.about: Lambing or meat lamb grow-out.

cycleTypes.label: Rabbit Batch
cycleTypes.about: Kits at weaning → market weight. Typically 70–90 days.

cycleTypes.label: Pond Grow-Out
cycleTypes.about: Fingerlings stocked into pond → harvest weight.

cycleTypes.label: Cage Culture
cycleTypes.about: Fish in floating cages in a lake or dam.

cycleTypes.label: Tank / RAS System
cycleTypes.about: Recirculating aquaculture system — controlled indoor environment.

cycleTypes.label: Shrimp Pond Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Post-larvae stocking → harvest. Typically 90–120 days.

cycleTypes.label: Aquaponics Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Fish + plants in a closed-loop system.

cycleTypes.label: Hatchery / Nursery Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Broodstock conditioning → spawning → larvae rearing → fingerlings.

cycleTypes.label: Rain-Fed Season
cycleTypes.about: Single rainy-season crop — maize, sorghum, groundnuts etc.

cycleTypes.label: Irrigated Season
cycleTypes.about: Irrigated crop — can span any calendar period.

cycleTypes.label: Nursery / Seedbed
cycleTypes.about: Seed germination and seedling raising before transplanting.

cycleTypes.label: Ratoon Crop
cycleTypes.about: Second harvest from the same root system (sugarcane, banana).

cycleTypes.label: Transplant Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Seedling transplant → harvest. For tomato, cabbage, kale, pepper.

cycleTypes.label: Direct-Sown Crop
cycleTypes.about: Seed direct in field — carrot, beetroot, onion, watermelon.

cycleTypes.label: Perennial Season
cycleTypes.about: Track a growing season on a perennial vegetable (chilli, eggplant).

cycleTypes.label: Hydroponic Cycle
cycleTypes.about: NFT, DWC, or drip lettuce / herbs / spinach cycle.

cycleTypes.label: Greenhouse Tomato
cycleTypes.about: Transplant to first pick to end-of-season for greenhouse tomato.

cycleTypes.label: Cut Flower Production
cycleTypes.about: Planting to first cut and repeat cycles for roses, carnations.

cycleTypes.label: Strawberry Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Transplant to first harvest and peak production window.

cycleTypes.label: Annual Production Season
cycleTypes.about: Track flowering → fruit set → harvest → post-harvest for one year.

cycleTypes.label: New Orchard Planting
cycleTypes.about: Land prep → planting → establishment phase for new trees.

cycleTypes.label: Harvest Window
cycleTypes.about: Focus on the active harvest period only.

cycleTypes.label: Honey Production Season
cycleTypes.about: Colony build-up → main flow → extraction → post-harvest assessment.

cycleTypes.label: Colony Build-Up
cycleTypes.about: Package or nuc → full colony establishment.

cycleTypes.label: Queen Rearing Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Cell grafting → capping → emergence → mating → laying.

cycleTypes.label: Spawn Block Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Inoculation → colonisation → pinning → fruiting → end-of-life.

cycleTypes.label: Bag Spawn Cycle
cycleTypes.about: Substrate bags inoculated and cycled through fruiting.

cycleTypes.label: Processing Batch
cycleTypes.about: A defined batch of raw material through the processing line.

cycleTypes.label: Monthly Operation
cycleTypes.about: Track one calendar month of processing activity.

cycleTypes.label: Service Contract
cycleTypes.about: A defined service engagement — consulting, training, vet rounds.

cycleTypes.label: Equipment Hire Period
cycleTypes.about: Track utilisation and returns for hired equipment.
